mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, summary_date as summaryDate, total_calories as totalCalories, total_protein as totalProtein, total_fat as totalFat, total_carbohydrates as totalCarbohydrates, breakfast_calories as breakfastCalories, lunch_calories as lunchCalories, dinner_calories as dinnerCalories, snack_calories as snackCalories, night_calories as nightCalories FROM diet_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND summary_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY summary_date DESC
